meta.description: Per-model rf-mcp instruction-quality baselines for the agentic e2e gate. Lowering a number here is a human-reviewed ratchet: it means rf-mcp's tool descriptions / MCP instructions got measurably worse for a fixed model. Recapture with E2E_CAPTURE_BASELINE=1 (see tests/e2e/README.md).
meta.aggregation: median for rates, mean for completion
meta.capture_command: MINIMAX_API_KEY=... E2E_CAPTURE_BASELINE=1 E2E_RUNS=5 MINIMAX_MODELS=MiniMax-M3 uv run pytest tests/e2e/test_minimax_autonomous.py
